title: Bukukuwa da abokai
description: Ten short, simple stories about parties, festivals and friends in Hausaland: a seventh birthday, a wedding in Kano, a grandmother's Sallah meal for the poor in Maradi, a walking club in Kaduna, a teacher's farewell in Bauchi, a friend coming home from Lagos, a tax officer who refuses his friend's bribe, the Durbar in Katsina, farmers who build a store together and a girl's pillow for her grandmother's birthday.

lessons.title: Ranar haihuwar Farida
lessons.summary: On Farida's seventh birthday she washes the cups for her mother, opens the door to the guests, and her grandfather brings a box with beautiful red shoes.
lessons.text:
Yau ce ranar haihuwar Farida. Farida yarinya ce mai shekara bakwai. Mamanta ta shirya ƙaramin biki a gida, kuma ta kira abokan Farida da 'yan uwanta.

Da safe, Mama ta ce wa Farida, "Ki taimaka mini. Ki wanke kofuna, ni kuma zan dafa abinci."

Farida ta wanke kofuna goma, sannan ta wanke hannunta. Ta je wurin mamanta a ɗakin girki.

"Me kika wanke?" Mama ta ce.

"Na wanke kofuna goma, kuma na wanke hannuna," Farida ta ce.

"Eh, kin yi kyau," Mama ta ce. "Yanzu ki je ki sa sabuwar rigarki."

Da yamma, sai aka buga ƙofa.

"Waye?" Farida ta ce.

"Ni ne, Haris," wani yaro ya ce. Haris shi ne baƙo na farko. Ya kawo wa Farida littafi.

Sai aka sake buga ƙofa. "Waye?" Farida ta ce. Wannan karon, baƙo na biyu kakanta ne, Malam Danlami. Ya zo daga Zaria.

Kakanta ya zo da wani babban akwati. "Ga kyautarki," ya ce.

Farida ta buɗe akwatin. A cikin akwatin akwai kyawawan takalma masu launin ja.

"Kaka, waɗannan takalma kyawawa ne!" Farida ta ce. "Amma ina ganin suna da tsada."

"Eh, suna da ɗan tsada," kakanta ya ce. "Amma yau ranar haihuwarki ce."

Farida ta sa takalman nan take. Ta yi wasa da abokanta a waje har dare. Kowane baƙo ya ce takalmanta kyawawa ne.

Da baƙi suka tafi, Mama ta ce, "Farida, wace kyauta kika fi so a yau?"

"Takalmana!" Farida ta ce. "Kuma na ji daɗin ganin kakana."

"To, kafin ki kwanta, ki wanke ƙafafunki, ki sa takalman a cikin akwatinsu," mamanta ta ce.

Tambayoyi:
Farida tana da shekara nawa?
Farida tana da shekara bakwai.
Me Farida ta wanke da safe?
Ta wanke kofuna goma da hannunta.
Wane ne baƙo na farko?
Haris ne baƙo na farko.
Me ke cikin akwatin kakanta?
Akwai kyawawan takalma masu launin ja a cikin akwatin.
Me Farida ta ce game da takalman?
Ta ce suna da tsada.

lessons.title: Auren Mubarak
lessons.summary: Mubarak asks his father to let him marry his girlfriend Raliya; at the wedding party a singer plays the guitar, Mubarak puts a gold ring on her finger, and even his father jumps for joy.
lessons.text:
Mubarak saurayi ne mai shekara 28. Yana aiki a wani banki a Kano. Yana da budurwa mai suna Raliya. Budurwarsa malama ce a wata makarantar yara. Sun yi shekara biyu suna soyayya.

Wata rana Mubarak ya je wurin mahaifinsa, Alhaji Ubale. "Baba, ina so in auri Raliya," ya ce.

Alhaji Ubale ya yi murna. "Budurwarka yarinya ce mai hankali da kirki," ya ce. "Za mu je gidan iyayenta gobe."

Bayan kwana ɗaya, Alhaji Ubale da 'yan uwansa suka je gidan iyayen Raliya. Iyayenta suka yarda. Aka sa ranar aure.

Kafin ranar auren, Mubarak ya je kasuwa ya sayi zobe na zinari. Zoben zinari yana da tsada, amma Mubarak yana so ya ba Raliya abu mai kyau.

Ranar aure, aka yi auren a masallaci da safe. Da yamma, aka yi biki a wani babban fili. Wani mawaƙi ya zo da jitarsa. Mawaƙin ya fara kiɗa da jita. Sautin jitar yana da daɗi sosai. Mutane suka fara rawa, yara kuma suka fara tsalle a gaban mawaƙin.

Mubarak ya sa zoben zinari a yatsan Raliya. Raliya ta kalli yatsanta. "Zoben zinari ya yi kyau a yatsana," ta ce.

Mawaƙin ya yi waƙa game da Mubarak da Raliya. Sai Alhaji Ubale ya tashi, ya fara tsalle saboda farin ciki. Mutane suka yi dariya. "Har Alhaji ma yana tsalle!" wani yaro ya ce.

Da dare ya yi, mawaƙin ya daina kiɗa, kuma sautin jitarsa ya ƙare. Mubarak ya ce wa Raliya, "Yau na auri budurwata. Ina farin ciki sosai."

Tambayoyi:
Wace ce budurwar Mubarak?
Budurwar Mubarak ita ce Raliya.
Me Mubarak ya ce wa mahaifinsa?
Ya ce, "Ina so in auri Raliya."
Me Mubarak ya saya a kasuwa?
Ya sayi zobe na zinari.
Me mawaƙin ya zo da shi?
Mawaƙin ya zo da jitarsa.
Me ya sa Alhaji Ubale ya yi tsalle?
Ya yi tsalle saboda farin ciki.

lessons.title: Abincin salla
lessons.summary: Before the Small Sallah in Maradi, old Asiya sends her grandson Nasidi to collect rice, beans and pepper from the neighbours, and on Sallah morning they feed many poor people.
lessons.text:
Asiya tsohuwa ce. Tana zaune a Maradi tare da jikanta Nasidi. Gobe za a yi Ƙaramar Salla.

Kowace shekara, Asiya tana dafa abinci da yawa a ranar salla. Ba don iyalinta kaɗai take dafa abinci ba. Tana ba mutanen da suke fama da talauci.

"A garinmu akwai iyalai da yawa da suke cikin talauci," ta ce wa Nasidi. "Ba su da kuɗin abincin salla."

Nasidi ya ce, "Kaka, abincin namu ba zai isa ga kowa ba."

"Gaskiya ne," Asiya ta ce. "Saboda haka ka je ka tattara gudummawa daga maƙwabta."

Da yamma, Nasidi ya je gidajen maƙwabta ɗaya bayan ɗaya. Ya tattara gudummawa: wani ya ba shi shinkafa, wani ya ba shi wake, wata mace kuma ta ba shi yaji. Ya kawo wa kakarsa dukan abin da ya tattara.

"Ga gudummawar maƙwabta," ya ce. "Akwai shinkafa, da wake, da yaji."

"Allah ya ba ka albarka," Asiya ta ce.

Da safiyar salla, Asiya da Nasidi suka tashi da wuri. Bayan sun dawo daga masallaci, Asiya ta dafa wake da shinkafa. Ta sa yaji a cikin miya.

Da rana, ɗimbin mutane suka zo ƙofar gidansu: mata, yara da tsofaffi. Asiya ta ba kowa abinci. Nasidi ya ce, "Kaka, ɗimbin mutane sun zo fiye da yadda na zata!"

Wata tsohuwa ta ce, "Allah ya ba ki albarka, Asiya. Wakenki yana da daɗi, kuma yajinsa ya yi daidai."

Da yamma, Asiya ta ce wa Nasidi, "Albarkar salla tana cikin ba da abinci. Ka gani, abincin namu ya isa ga ɗimbin mutane, saboda gudummawar maƙwabta."

Nasidi ya ce, "Shekara mai zuwa, zan fara tattara gudummawa tun kafin salla ta zo."

Tambayoyi:
Me ya sa Asiya take ba mutane abinci a ranar salla?
Saboda suna cikin talauci, kuma ba su da kuɗin abincin salla.
Me Nasidi ya tattara daga maƙwabta?
Ya tattara gudummawa: shinkafa, wake da yaji.
Yaushe Asiya ta dafa abincin?
Ta dafa shi da safiyar salla.
Mutane nawa suka zo ƙofar gidansu?
Ɗimbin mutane suka zo ƙofar gidansu.
Me tsohuwar ta ce wa Asiya?
Ta ce, "Allah ya ba ki albarka."

lessons.title: Kulob ɗin tafiya
lessons.summary: In Kaduna, Zulaihat leads a walking club; the old man Abdulmalik joins on his doctor's advice, learns not to stop halfway, and the members celebrate his birthday at their monthly meeting.
lessons.text:
Zulaihat tana jagorantar wani kulob na tafiya a Kaduna. Kulob ɗin yana da membobi ashirin, maza da mata. Sau biyu a mako, membobin sukan haɗu da safe a wani babban fili kusa da kogi. Filin yana da sarari mai yawa, kuma babu motoci.

Wata rana, wani tsoho mai suna Abdulmalik ya zo. "Likita ya ce in dinga motsa jiki," ya ce. "Zan iya shiga kulob ɗin nan?"

"Eh, ka shigo," Zulaihat ta ce. "Ka zo gobe da safe."

Da safe, Zulaihat ta jagoranta tafiyar. Membobin suka yi tafiya zagaye da filin. Kowane zagaye yana ɗaukar minti takwas.

Bayan zagaye na biyu, Abdulmalik ya gaji. "Ina so in tsaya," ya ce.

"Kada ka tsaya," Zulaihat ta ce. "Tsayawa a tsakiyar tafiya ba ta da kyau. Ka rage sauri kawai."

Abdulmalik ya rage sauri, amma bai tsaya ba. Ya gama zagaye uku.

Bayan tafiya, membobin suka motsa jiki na minti goma a sararin filin. Sannan suka zauna a ƙarƙashin bishiya, suna hira mai daɗi. Suna magana game da iyalansu, aikinsu da labaran gari. Abdulmalik ya ji daɗin hira da su sosai.

Kowane wata, kulob ɗin yakan yi ganawa. A ganawar, membobin sukan tattauna game da hanyar tafiyarsu, da wanda zai jagoranta idan Zulaihat ba ta nan.

Bayan wata ɗaya, Abdulmalik ya yi zagaye biyar ba tare da tsayawa ba. Kuma ya yi minti arba'in yana tafiya.

A ganawar ƙarshen wata, Zulaihat ta ce, "Yau ranar haihuwar Abdulmalik ce. Yana da shekara 70." Membobin suka kawo masa ƙaramar kyauta, suka yi masa waƙa.

Abdulmalik ya ce, "Na gode. Kafin in shiga kulob ɗin nan, ba na iya tafiya minti goma. Yanzu ina motsa jiki, kuma ina da sababbin abokai."

Tambayoyi:
Wa take jagorantar kulob ɗin tafiya?
Zulaihat ce take jagorantar kulob ɗin.
Kulob ɗin yana da membobi nawa?
Yana da membobi ashirin.
Kowane zagaye yana ɗaukar minti nawa?
Kowane zagaye yana ɗaukar minti takwas.
Me membobin suke yi a ƙarƙashin bishiya?
Suna hira game da iyalansu, aikinsu da labaran gari.
Me membobin suka yi a ganawar ƙarshen wata?
Sun kawo wa Abdulmalik kyauta, suka yi masa waƙa.

lessons.title: Malam Garzali zai huta
lessons.summary: After thirty-five years of teaching at a secondary school in Bauchi, Malam Garzali retires; his pupils hold a party, a former pupil thanks him for his training, and he tells them teaching is a trust.
lessons.text:
Malam Garzali ya yi shekara 35 yana koyarwa a wata makarantar sakandare a Bauchi. Yanzu lokaci ya yi da zai huta.

Ɗaliban ajin ƙarshe suka ce, "Mu shirya masa biki kafin ya tafi." Shugabar ajin, Ramla, ta tattara gudummawa daga ɗalibai.

Suka tattauna game da kyautar da za su ba shi. Wani ya ce, "Mu ba shi riga." Wani kuma ya ce, "Mu ba shi littafi." Ramla ta ce, "Mu duba dacewar kowace kyauta. Malam Garzali yana son zuwa aji da wuri. Agogo shi ne kyauta mafi dacewa." Kowa ya yarda.

Ranar bikin, ɗaliban makarantar gabaɗaya suka zo babban ɗakin taro. Malamai da ma'aikatan makarantar ma sun zo.

Shugaban makarantar ya yi jawabi. "Malam Garzali ma'aikaci ne nagari," ya ce. "A shekaru 35, bai taɓa makara zuwa aji ba. Ya kawo wa makarantarmu ɗaukaka. Ɗalibansa da yawa sun zama likitoci, lauyoyi da malamai."

Sai wani saurayi mai suna Bilyaminu ya tashi. Shi malami ne a makarantar yanzu. "Ni ma ɗalibin Malam Garzali ne a da," ya ce. "Ya ba ni horo a aji da kuma a filin ƙwallo. Horonsa ne ya sa na zama malami."

A ƙarshe, Malam Garzali ya tashi. "Na gode muku gabaɗaya," ya ce. "Koyarwa amana ce. Iyaye sun ba mu 'ya'yansu amana. Alhakin malami ne ya koya musu darasi da kuma hali mai kyau. Kada ku manta da wannan darasi: duk aikin da aka ba ku, ku riƙe shi da amana. Wannan alhakinku ne."

Ramla ta ba shi agogon. Malam Garzali ya yi murmushi. "Zan dinga duba wannan agogo, ina tunawa da ku," ya ce.

Ɗaliban suka ce, "Allah ya ɗaukaka ka, Malam."

Tambayoyi:
Malam Garzali ya yi shekara nawa yana koyarwa?
Ya yi shekara 35 yana koyarwa a makarantar sakandare.
Me ya sa Ramla ta ce agogo ne kyauta mafi dacewa?
Saboda Malam Garzali yana son zuwa aji da wuri.
Me shugaban makarantar ya ce game da Malam Garzali?
Ya ce shi ma'aikaci ne nagari, kuma ya kawo wa makarantar ɗaukaka.
Me Malam Garzali ya ba Bilyaminu?
Ya ba shi horo a aji da kuma a filin ƙwallo.
Me Malam Garzali ya ce game da koyarwa?
Ya ce koyarwa amana ce.

lessons.title: Dawowar Mubashir
lessons.summary: Mubashir works in Lagos and sends his friend Jabir videos of the sea and of a big machine; when he says he is coming back to the north, Jabir and their friends prepare a party for his return.
lessons.text:
Jabir da Mubashir abokai ne tun suna yara a Kano. Shekara biyu da suka wuce, Mubashir ya sami aiki a Legas, a kudancin Najeriya.

A kudanci, Mubashir ya fuskanci matsaloli da yawa. Ya fuskanci zafi da ruwan sama mai yawa, kuma bai iya yaren mutanen wurin ba. Amma ya koyi aikinsa da kyau.

Kowane wata, Mubashir yakan aiko wa Jabir da bidiyo ta waya. A wani bidiyo, ya nuna wa Jabir teku. A wani bidiyo kuma, ya nuna masa wata babbar na'ura a kamfaninsu. "Wannan na'ura tana yin aikin mutane ɗari," ya ce a cikin bidiyon.

Wata rana Mubashir ya aiko da sabon bidiyo. "Jabir, ina da labari mai daɗi," ya ce. "Zan dawo arewaci ba da jimawa ba. Kamfaninmu zai buɗe sabon ofis a Kano, kuma ni ne zan yi aiki a can."

Jabir ya yi murna sosai. Ya kira Mubashir. "Yaushe ne dawowarka?" ya ce.

"Ƙila a ƙarshen wata," Mubashir ya ce. "Amma zai yiwu in zo kafin haka."

Jabir ya kira sauran abokansu. "Mubashir zai dawo ba da jimawa ba," ya ce. "Mu shirya masa biki domin dawowarsa."

Bayan mako uku, Mubashir ya dawo arewaci. Jabir da abokansu suka je filin jirgin sama domin su same shi.

A gidan Jabir, aka yi ƙaramin biki. Aka dafa abinci, aka kawo lemo. Mubashir ya ce, "Na fuskanci wahala a kudanci, amma yanzu na dawo gida. Ina jin daɗin dawowa wurin abokaina."

"Za ka koma Legas?" Jabir ya ce.

"Ƙila wata rana," Mubashir ya ce. "Zai yiwu kamfanin ya sake aiko ni can. Amma yanzu ina nan tare da ku."

Jabir ya ɗauki bidiyon bikin da wayarsa. "Wannan bidiyo zai tuna mana da ranar dawowarka," ya ce.

Tambayoyi:
Ina Mubashir ya sami aiki?
Ya sami aiki a Legas, a kudancin Najeriya.
Me Mubashir ya fuskanta a kudanci?
Ya fuskanci zafi, ruwan sama mai yawa, da matsalar yare.
Me Mubashir ya nuna a cikin bidiyonsa?
Ya nuna teku, da wata babbar na'ura a kamfaninsu.
Me ya sa Mubashir zai dawo arewaci?
Saboda kamfaninsu zai buɗe sabon ofis a Kano.
Me abokansa suka shirya domin dawowarsa?
Sun shirya masa biki.

lessons.title: Abokin da ya ƙi rashawa
lessons.summary: Muhsin, a tax officer, refuses a bribe from his old friend Hamman, and they stop speaking; when a judge punishes another officer for bribery, Hamman sees that Muhsin was right and they make peace.
lessons.text:
Muhsin da Hamman sun shafe shekara ashirin suna abokai. Sun yi karatu tare a makaranta. Yanzu Muhsin ma'aikaci ne a ofishin haraji na gundumarsu a Kano. Hamman kuma ɗan kasuwa ne. Yana da babban shago a gundumar.

Wata rana Hamman ya zo ofishin Muhsin. "Harajin shagona ya yi yawa a bana," ya ce. "Ka taimake ni, ka rage shi. Ga wannan kuɗi, naka ne."

Muhsin ya duba kuɗin. "Hamman, wannan rashawa ce," ya ce. "Ba zan karɓi rashawa ba." Muhsin ya yi watsi da kuɗin, ya mayar wa Hamman.

Hamman ya yi fushi. Ya fita ba tare da magana ba. Daga ranar, aka yi shiru tsakanin abokan biyu. Hamman ba ya kiran Muhsin, Muhsin ma ba ya kiransa. Shirun ya ɗauki wata uku.

Wata rana, aka kai wani ma'aikacin haraji kotu. Ya karɓi rashawa daga 'yan kasuwa da yawa. Alƙali ya saurari shaidu, sannan ya yanke masa hukunci mai tsanani. "Rashawa tana lalata ƙasa," alƙalin ya ce.

Hamman ya ji labarin a rediyo. Sai ya gane a zahiri cewa Muhsin ya yi daidai. Da Muhsin ya karɓi kuɗinsa, da su biyu suna cikin matsala yanzu.

Hamman ya je gidan Muhsin da dare. "Abokina, na yi kuskure," ya ce. "A zahiri, ka kare ni daga babbar matsala."

Muhsin ya yi murmushi. "Ina son abotarmu," ya ce. "Amma ma'amalarmu da gwamnati dole ta zama ta gaskiya."

"Haka ne," Hamman ya ce. "Daga yau zan kyautata ma'amalata da gwamnati. Zan biya dukan harajina."

Suka shafe awa biyu suna hira. Shirun da ke tsakaninsu ya ƙare. Kuma Hamman ya kyautata kasuwancinsa: yana rubuta komai a littafi, yana biyan haraji a kan lokaci.

Tambayoyi:
Shekara nawa Muhsin da Hamman suka shafe suna abokai?
Sun shafe shekara ashirin suna abokai.
Ina Muhsin yake aiki?
Yana aiki a ofishin haraji na gundumarsu.
Me Muhsin ya yi da kuɗin Hamman?
Ya yi watsi da kuɗin, ya mayar wa Hamman.
Me alƙalin ya ce?
Ya ce, "Rashawa tana lalata ƙasa."
Me Hamman ya ce zai yi daga yau?
Ya ce zai kyautata ma'amalarsa da gwamnati, ya biya dukan harajinsa.

lessons.title: Dawakin salla a Katsina
lessons.summary: Two friends from Funtua watch the Durbar in Katsina: palace guards, horsemen with shields and old weapons, gun salutes, praise singers and an expert rider who turns his horse before the emir.
lessons.text:
Ahmad da Hassan abokai ne daga Funtua. Bayan Ƙaramar Salla, suka je Katsina domin kallon bikin dawaki na salla. Ɗimbin mutane sun zo daga garuruwa da yawa.

Suka tsaya kusa da ƙofar gidan sarki. Masu gadin gidan sarki suna tsaye a ƙofar, sun sa manyan riguna ja. Aikinsu shi ne gadin sarki da gidansa.

Sai masu dawaki suka fito. Kowanne yana riƙe da garkuwa a hannunsa ɗaya, da mashi a ɗaya hannun. Waɗansu kuma suna riƙe da bindiga.

"Me ya sa suke riƙe da makamai?" Hassan ya ce.

"A da, su ne sojojin sarki," Ahmad ya ce. "Garkuwa da makamai suna nuna tarihinsu. Amma yau ba don yaƙi suke riƙe da waɗannan makamai ba."

Sai aka fara harbi. Waɗansu mutane suna harbin bindiga sama. Ƙarar harbin tana da ƙarfi sosai. Waɗansu yara suka ji tsoro, suka rufe kunnuwansu.

Sai sarki ya fito a kan wani babban farin doki. Mawaƙa suna tafiya a gabansa, suna yi masa waƙa. Mawaƙan suna kiɗa, suna faɗin tarihin sarakunan Katsina.

Wani ƙwararren mai doki ya zo da sauri. Da ya kai gaban sarki, ya yi juyi da dokinsa, sannan ya tsaya. Mutane suka yi murna. Ya sake yin juyi, ya koma wurinsa.

"Kai, wannan ƙwararre ne!" Hassan ya ce.

Rana tana da zafi. Hassan ya ce, "Bari in je sayen ruwa." Ya je wurin wasu mata da suke sayar da ruwa da abinci. Bayan sayen ruwan, ya dawo wurin Ahmad.

Da yamma, suka koma Funtua. Hassan ya ce, "Ban taɓa ganin ƙwararren mai doki kamar wannan ba. Shekara mai zuwa, za mu sake zuwa."

Tambayoyi:
Ina Ahmad da Hassan suka je bayan Ƙaramar Salla?
Sun je Katsina domin kallon bikin dawaki na salla.
Wane aiki masu gadin suke yi?
Aikinsu shi ne gadin sarki da gidansa.
Me masu dawaki suke riƙe da shi?
Suna riƙe da garkuwa da mashi.
Me mawaƙa suke yi a gaban sarki?
Suna yi masa waƙa, suna kiɗa.
Me ƙwararren mai dokin ya yi a gaban sarki?
Ya yi juyi da dokinsa, sannan ya tsaya.

lessons.title: Ɗakin ajiyar manoma
lessons.summary: Near Gombe, monkeys and birds eat the farmers' grain; instead of shooting the animals, the farmers join together to build a store of wood, rescue a boy from a breaking branch while they work, and hold a party.
lessons.text:
A wani ƙauye kusa da Gombe, manoma suna noman masara da gyaɗa. Bayan sun tattara amfanin gona, sukan ajiye shi a waje kusa da gidajensu.

Amma kowace shekara, halittun daji suna zuwa su ci abincin. Birai suna zuwa da rana, tsuntsaye kuma suna zuwa da safe. Wannan yana ba manoman takaici sosai.

Wata rana manoman suka yi taro a ƙarƙashin wata babbar bishiya. Wani manomi mai suna Inusa ya ce, "Takaicina ya yi yawa! Mu harbe biran da tsuntsayen!"

Shugaban manoman, Malam Sambo, ya ce, "A'a, kada mu harbe su. Su ma halittun Allah ne. Bari mu haɗe kanmu, mu gina babban ɗakin ajiya. Idan abincinmu yana cikin ɗakin ajiya, halittun daji ba za su same shi ba."

Manoman suka yarda. Suka haɗe kai, suka fara aiki. Kowa ya kawo itace daga daji. Wasu suka yanka itace, wasu suka haɗa ƙasa da ruwa.

Da rana, wani yaro, ɗan Inusa, ya hau wata bishiya domin ya ga aikin daga sama. Sai reshen da yake kansa ya karye. Yaron ya kama wani reshe, yana kuka.

Manoman suka bar aikinsu, suka gudu zuwa bishiyar. Malam Sambo ya kawo dogon itace, suka sa shi a jikin bishiyar. Inusa ya hau, ya kama ɗansa, ya sauka da shi. Ceton yaron bai ɗauki lokaci mai yawa ba. Inusa ya gode wa kowa saboda cetonsa.

Bayan mako biyu, ɗakin ajiyar ya kammala. Manoman suka sa masararsu da gyaɗarsu a ciki. Birai da tsuntsaye ba su sami komai ba.

Da yamma, manoman suka yi biki. Malam Sambo ya ce, "Mun shawo kan matsalar halittun daji ba tare da mun harbe su ba. Takaicinmu ya ƙare. Idan muka haɗe, za mu iya shawo kan kowace matsala."

Tambayoyi:
Me ya ba manoman takaici?
Halittun daji suna cin abincinsu.
Me Inusa ya ce su yi?
Ya ce su harbe biran da tsuntsayen.
Me Malam Sambo ya ce su gina?
Ya ce su haɗe, su gina babban ɗakin ajiya.
Me ya faru da ɗan Inusa?
Reshen da yake kansa ya karye, kuma manoma suka kawo masa ceto.
Me manoman suka yi bayan ɗakin ajiyar ya kammala?
Sun yi biki.

lessons.title: Matashin Nabila
lessons.summary: For her grandmother's birthday, Nabila designs a pillow embroidered with their house; it wins the school vote, a shopkeeper offers to advertise it, and her grandmother sleeps well on it.
lessons.text:
Nabila 'yar makarantar sakandare ce a Kano. Kakarta za ta yi ranar haihuwa a wata mai zuwa. Bara, Nabila ta saya mata riga. Amma a bana, tana so ta yi kyauta da hannunta.

Kakarta takan ce, "Matashina ya tsufa. Ba na barci da kyau a kansa." Sai Nabila ta yanke shawara: za ta yi wa kakarta sabon matashi.

Nabila ta ƙirƙiro wani sabon zane. A zanen akwai gidansu, wata bishiya, da sunan kakarta. Ta ɗinka zanen a jikin matashin da zare kala uku.

A wannan lokaci, makarantarsu ta shirya gasar ayyukan hannu. Bara wani yaro ne ya ci gasar. Malamarsu ta tambaye ta, "Nabila, za ki kawo wani aiki?"

"Eh, zan kawo matashi," Nabila ta ce.

Ranar gasar, ɗalibai suka kawo ayyuka da yawa. Malamar ta ce, "Kowane ɗalibi yana da ƙuri'a ɗaya. Wanne aiki ne ya fi kyau? Ku jefa ƙuri'arku."

Ɗaliban suka jefa ƙuri'unsu. Matashin Nabila ya sami ƙuri'a 50. Ya zamo na farko a gasar.

Wani baƙo, mai shagon kayan ɗaki, ya zo kallon gasar. Ya tambaye su, "Wannan matashi na wa ne?"

"Nata ne," malamar ta ce, tana nuna Nabila. "Zanen ma nata ne: ita ce ta ƙirƙiro shi."

Mai shagon ya ce wa Nabila, "Kin ƙirƙiro abu mai kyau. Kawo mini matashi goma, zan yi musu talla a shagona. Talla za ta sa mutane su san aikinki."

Ranar haihuwar kakarta, Nabila ta ba ta matashin. Kakarta ta ga sunanta a jikin matashin, ta yi murna sosai. Da safe ta ce, "Na yi barci kamar yarinya. Wannan matashi ya zamo abin da na fi so a gidan nan."

Tambayoyi:
Me Nabila ta saya wa kakarta bara?
Bara, ta saya mata riga.
Me Nabila ta ƙirƙiro?
Ta ƙirƙiro wani sabon zane a jikin matashi.
Me malamar ta tambaye ta?
Ta tambaye ta ko za ta kawo wani aiki.
Wanne aiki ne ya zamo na farko a gasar?
Matashin Nabila ne ya zamo na farko.
Ƙuri'a nawa matashin Nabila ya samu?
Ya sami ƙuri'a 50.
Me mai shagon ya ce zai yi?
Ya ce zai yi wa matashin Nabila talla a shagonsa.
